title: Draper's Acres Campground

services.name: Tent Sites
services.desc: Wooded tent sites sell out fast on weekends. Do your best to reserve a week to 2 weeks in advance. Our Campground has a variety of tent sites that accommodate between 1-6 people. Some sites offer water/electric and some are primitive sites. We have a lot of private tent sites, but when they fill up there are alternative spaces available in a grassy field. Water/electric tent sites cost $50/night. They are large enough to accommodate smaller pop up campers or small tear drop

blurb: Draper's Acres is a family run campground in Lake Placid, NY. We are not a camping resort. This campground is simply home base for those who choose to embrace the nature surrounding us. Those of you looking for camping resorts should check out the neighboring town of Wilmington.
